death.note: saint.gr: «Μαρτύρησε επί Μαξιμιανού (286 - 305 μ.Χ.)». The interval is that reign, which is as close as the page comes to a year.

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 12 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It names its witness plainly — «Η μνήμη του Αγίου Αιθέριου αναφέρεται στον Παρισινό Κώδικα 1611» — which is a source cited and not the site's own mark of doubt; there is no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The corpus keeps an `aetherius-martyr-18-june` and an `aetherius-of-cherson`, both on other days; those are other entries on the same calendar and therefore other commemorations, and nothing on this page joins this man to either. No hymn is printed.
